verdict.rationale: Plausible documents a CSV 'Export stats' feature for downloading data, plus a Stats API for programmatic access, and is fully open-source/self-hostable, which the community explicitly praises as an exit-safety feature ('if the company disappears, you can continue using what got developed so far, and maintain it yourself'). This directly satisfies exporting data in open formats and being able to leave (self-host or migrate). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of raw/full event-level export (vs aggregate CSV stats), no independent verification of export completeness, and no llms.txt/openapi spec for AI-native tooling discovery (probes show 404s).
